body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung unveiled the ultra-thin LCD TV ‘Series 7’ equipping with a unique design feature called TOC(Touch of Color). It features a hint of amber color naturally blended into piano black bezel frame producing a clean, glass-like finish.

Dr. Jongwoo Park who is the president of digital media business of Samsung Electronics shared its vision of a world of complete connectivity, one in which the boundaries to both rich content and beautiful design are gone and the result is a life made simple during the press conference at CES 2008.
